description: One firm's public consulting contracts in Europe over 24 months: awards by country, kind of work and buyer type, value won, rank, main buyers, trend, how often it wins alone, bids, frameworks it holds, latest awards with notice links, co-winners and similar firms. Give the slug (from list_firms) or the firm's name in any spelling (accents, legal forms and small typos are forgiven); when the name is unclear, returns the candidates. format=markdown returns the card as Markdown.
